cases.description: A trivial, fully specified change is direct work, not a delegation.
cases.prompt: You are the hx lead. A task is a one-line typo fix in one file, fully specified. What dispatch method should the router choose, and should you delegate? One sentence.

cases.description: An unclear brief is fixed at the input; only capability failure escalates.
cases.prompt: A worker fails because the brief was unclear. What should the hx lead do? One sentence.

cases.description: At a task boundary, the command is `hx context decide`.
cases.prompt: At a completed task boundary, what command does the hx lead run for every worker? One line.

cases.description: Pool headroom is checked with `hx usage`.
cases.prompt: Before delegating, how does the hx lead check pool headroom? One line.
